wages.text: Takano has repeatedly backed raising the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour and supports labor unions.
wages.quote: Raising the federal minimum wage would lift millions out of poverty and provide workers with a livable wage as we rebuild and emerge from this pandemic.

debt.text: Takano pledges to oppose benefit cuts and privatization of Medicare and Social Security.
debt.quote: I will fight back against attempts to turn Medicare into a privatized voucher program that shifts costs to seniors and those with disabilities.

schools.text: Takano, a former public school teacher, emphasizes strong investment in public education.
schools.quote: future economic prosperity requires a strong investment in public education and workforce training today

safety.text: Takano supports reducing incarceration through probation for low-level offenses and changes to drug sentencing.
safety.quote: The federal government spends billions of dollars annually on funding our prisons and I believe there are a few simple reforms, like expanding the use of probation for low-level offenders and reexamining sentencing laws for drug offenders, that can reduce the cost of our prison systems, while maintaining public safety.

immigration.text: Takano supports expanded legal pathways to citizenship for asylum seekers, Dreamers, and undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: We need to create more expeditious legal pathways to citizenship for people who are seeking asylum, deliver more resources for migrants at the border, and develop a fair pathway to citizenship for undocumented immigrants.

guns.text: Takano supported the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act to expand background checks and has pushed for gun violence prevention measures.
guns.quote: I was proud to support the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, signed into law last Congress, to expand background check requirements

abortion.text: Takano supports abortion rights, cosponsoring federal protections and pledging to defend the right to choose.
abortion.quote: I will continue to defend a women's right to choose and I will work to protect Roe v. Wade.

health.text: Takano is a cosponsor and vocal advocate of the Medicare for All Act to guarantee public health coverage.
health.quote: I am a staunch advocate of the Medicare for All Act.

energy.text: Takano supports the Green New Deal and aggressive action to cut carbon emissions.
energy.quote: I am proud to support the Green New Deal, a comprehensive and ambitious proposal to achieve global net-zero emissions by 2050.

voting.text: Takano cosponsored the Voter Empowerment Act and advocates making voting more accessible for eligible voters.
voting.quote: The right to cast a ballot is a cornerstone of our democracy and we must ensure that anyone who is eligible to vote can do so easily.

housing.text: Manos calls affordable, market-rate housing the district's greatest need and wants to remove barriers that raise housing costs.
housing.quote: We need to remove the barriers to housing that have made that basic asset attractive to giant hedge funds.
